entities.summary: Harris Scott Barton is an American fund manager and a former professional football player. He played as an offensive tackle for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). A two-time first-team All-Pro, he won three Super Bowls with the 49ers. He played college football for the North Carolina Tar Heels.
